rationale: Edge-case was the only applicable lens for this compact/no-spec round (blind, acceptance, and verification-gap are all n/a) and it ran clean, but the genuine no-spec status caps confidence at low. It surfaced two blocking defects verified against source: CR-001, an orphan divider that renders above the lone Unassign item in community-edition rows because the divider is pushed unconditionally after the isEnterpriseEdition() gate; and CR-002, a dangling contextId that targets an id never rendered in the row, so every kebab trigger loses its per-user accessible name. One pre-existing tooltip-fallback risk was deferred and one divider-adjacency edge case in NavigationMore was dismissed as unreachable from any current call site; the standards audit is na (not expected for this profile, no coverage gap).

findings.title: Orphan divider renders in community-edition rows
findings.problem: The divider menu item (`menuItems.push({ title: 'divider-...', divider: true })`) is pushed unconditionally right after the `isEnterpriseEdition()` gate that adds the analytics item, so when EE is disabled the analytics item is skipped but the divider is still added.
findings.impact: In community-edition deployments every row's actions menu shows a stray separator line above the single 'Unassign from Project' item, a visibly broken-looking dropdown introduced by this change.
findings.recommendation: Only push the divider when the analytics item was also pushed — move the divider push inside the `if (isEnterpriseEdition())` block, or guard it on `menuItems.length > 0`.

findings.title: Kebab menu contextId targets a missing element id
findings.problem: `contextId={`user-more-${user.id}`}` is passed to NavigationMore, but no element in the row carries that id — the member-name span in the `user` column render has no `id` attribute.
findings.impact: NavigationMore's `aria-labelledby` assumes contextId resolves to a real element; since it does not, every row's kebab trigger falls back to the generic sr-only 'More options' text, losing the per-member accessible name for screen-reader users.
findings.recommendation: Give the member-name span `id={`user-more-${user.id}`}` matching the contextId value so aria-labelledby resolves correctly.
